title: COR-291: Probe *.localhost Via Loopback So Ngramx Up Still Writes .ngramx.lock On WSL
description: Probes localhost-family app URLs via 127.0.0.1 with the correct Host header, writes .ngramx.lock before the HTTP probe, and hints /etc/hosts when *.localhost does not resolve on WSL.

test_plan.description: Namespaced up on WSL still writes the lock when *.localhost does not resolve
steps: On WSL, with another stack occupying ports 80/443, run ngramx up --avoid-conflicts in a project whose docker.app_url is https://<name>.localhost
Confirm .ngramx.lock is written with the namespaced compose project
Confirm ngramx shell attaches to the namespaced primary service

test_plan.description: HTTP probe still flags a real 5xx via loopback Host header
steps: With a *.localhost app_url, stop or break php-fpm so nginx returns 502
Run ngramx up (or wait for the post-start probe)
Confirm up exits non-zero citing HTTP 502
Confirm .ngramx.lock was still written before the failure

test_plan.description: Unresolvable *.localhost prints an /etc/hosts hint without writing the file
steps: Ensure <name>.localhost is not in /etc/hosts and does not resolve in WSL
